name: harness-capabilities
question: Which native harness features does the current session's harness expose (version-keyed capability map)?
cost_provenance: measured 2026-07-10 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment): env checks ~0ms + one `claude --version` invocation measured 0.4s; pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01 -- under-declaration causes timeout kills

schema.version: string|null (harness version; null when harness unknown or version undetectable -- null forces every version-keyed bit false)
schema.capabilities: flat map of the 12 frozen boolean bits (workflowTool, nativeWorktrees, monitor, monitorWebsocket, sendMessage, sharedTaskList, bundledReviewSkills, loopScheduleWakeup, cronLocal, agentTeams, forkSubagents, backgroundSubagents) -- undetectable => false, never guessed
schema.briefing: string (double-quote-free summary line; ADVISORY -- excluded from the frozen consuming semantics, HAL branches read capabilities only)

freshness.note: The map is point-in-time; consumers treat a persisted map older than the current session as stale-but-usable (advisory) per HAL_CAPABILITY_MAP.md section 3.4 -- a stale map risks only a wrongly-false fast path, never breakage.

fallback: Check env CLAUDECODE=1 or CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID for Claude Code; run `claude --version` for the version; then consult the version->capability floor table in HAL_CAPABILITY_MAP.md section 2. Non-Claude or undetectable harness => treat every capability as false and take the ULDF path (which always works). NEVER guess a capability from adjacency.

provenance.note: The HAL (Harness Abstraction Layer) detection engine -- DEC-156. Output schema is FROZEN in claude-template/templates/HAL_CAPABILITY_MAP.md; a schema change there is a spec-level event. The version->capability floor table lives HERE (in the run scripts), NOT in consuming skills -- skills branch only via segments/_hal-gate.md. Conservative floors (2.1.205/2.1.206 for rolling features) are deliberate: a false-false costs only a missed fast path, never breakage. Test seams HARNESS_CAPS_FORCE_VERSION / HARNESS_CAPS_NOW exist solely so validators can pin golden fixtures; never set them in normal operation.
